notes.title: Quality Of Life Update (3/3) Rift, Locomotion, Pretty Glass + Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28746887/03506341b4d561e46d0e3c98ab5b24ef3a3f80ba.png[/img]
Hi All:

Finally. Here's the third quality of life update that wraps up basic CO1 functionality.  Check out the list of features and fixes below, now that fixes are out of the way, I can get back to the juicy stuff.  Continue reading for future update info.

3/3 Update:

- Added full Rift support including Rift tutorial graphics
- Smooth Locomotion
  - Press Thumbpad or Push Joystick forward to teleport
  - Press Lower Thumbpad or Push Joystick back to locomote in direction of 
    pointing
- Dedicated button to drop tools, press Application Menu or Y/B buttons to 
  drop tools
- Parachuting into water won't kill your game
- New teleport arc graphics, replaces default unity line drawer
- New glass shaders look cool and are very fast

Whats Next?
Now that the engine supports both major platforms, it's time to move onto enganging gameplay, expect something unique, exciting and offbeat, while satifsying your vr survival needs! Intelligent NPCs, dynamic story telling, more items to interact with and more contruction elements to build your ideal island are coming soon!

As always, thank you for supporting Country of One so early, you will not be dissapointed, that's a prommise!

notes.title: Upcoming control changes based on community feedback.
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,
Now that I had some time to assimilate community feedback, here are the proposed changes to the control scheme:

-Left or right hand inventory displays
-Trigger picks up, and calls primary action on items 
-Application button drops items
-Teleport by pointing controller in desired direction higher than 70 degrees, point lower than 70 degrees for smooth locomotion in the direction of the pointing
 
Let me know what you think!

notes.title: (1/3) Quality of Life update! Fixes for annoying things.
notes.notes:
This is the first of a series of 3 updates that should adress all the major glaring bugs.

- Bag over left shoulder removes items
- Should be able to continue a saved game
- Stream shader stereo error fix
- Limit to lowest altitude, shouldn't fall through terrain 
- Can teleport while holding a pickaxe
- Owl is somewhat better behaved, but the colliders will be fixed in the next update
- Z Fighting on textures fixed
- Radio volume dropoff and general volume adjustment
- Shotgun Dupe Removed
- Continue button fixed (greyed out until first save)
- Menu opens with left hand only
- Correct Dirt Prefab is used


Thanks so much for upgrading and as always, report all bugs to the forums.
